screens.subject: Family Secret Santa
body: We all agreed the Secret Santa limit was £10 this year.
Your gift for Grandma is a full Made by Mitchell makeup bag. Everyone else gave her a candle and now they look like they didn't try.
Can you explain why the limit didn't apply to you?

screens.subject: Family Secret Santa
body: Before you email all fourteen of us again, maybe just ask me what it cost?
Also Grandma was meant to find out who her Secret Santa was on Christmas Day. Not on a Tuesday.

screens.subject: Family Secret Santa
body: There is no way a bag that full came in at £10.
Rules are rules. Either swap it for something within budget or tell everyone what you really spent.

screens.subject: Family Secret Santa
body: It was £10 on TikTok Shop. Exactly on budget. It just looks expensive.
Next time, check the price before you put Grandma's present on blast.
Looking forward to your apology. Reply all, please.
